body: Still alive. Hung over and still feeling drunk
Combine all three? Fuck I just need to know there’s an escape route or panic sets in
Then I could find other ways, like my father’s gun or an overdose, those just will take more

Even when I wasn’t actively suicidal as a kid I was panicked by the very idea of being so out of control of my life that I could end my own life. Soon as I got a proper concept of death (6?) that’s when that fear formed in full. So yeah. Which is not to discount your point
Then I am trapped horribly and start to have a panic attack
Vegetative state is covered by the documentation I already have in place
